text:
In the world teetering on the brink of destruction, the chosen one, Kai was destined to harness the ancient magic to restore balance. The original tale ends with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world, but at the cost of his human existence.

**Alternative Ending:**

Instead of dissolving into the ether, Kai realized that the ancient magic was not a force to be consumed, but a bridge to be crossed. As the void threatened to swallow him, he did not let go of his humanity; instead, he anchored himself with the memories of those he loved. The magic, recognizing the strength of his will rather than the emptiness of his spirit, did not erase him. It wove his consciousness into the fabric of the world without stripping away his body. Kai survived, not as a god or a spirit, but as a mortal guardian who could now feel the pulse of the earth. He walked away from the crater, scarred but whole, ready to rebuild the world he had saved, proving that balance could be restored without the sacrifice of the self.

The capital of France is Paris.
